guardLocked.title: Lock the composer guard on
guardLocked.description: When true, the Maskroom guard is always on and the user cannot turn it off (bar toggle and options checkbox become inert). Set by administrators via managed policy; read-only to the user.

userId.title: Deprecated (ignored since 0.2.0)
userId.description: No longer used: the audit trail attributes activity to the signed-in user. Remove this key from your policy.

orgId.title: Deprecated (ignored since 0.2.0)
orgId.description: No longer used. Remove this key from your policy.

serverUrl.title: Maskroom server URL
serverUrl.description: The Maskroom server every install uses (e.g. https://maskroom.yourco.example). When set by policy it overrides and locks the per-user Server URL field.
